title: UtilityPilot — Practical tools for everyday digital tasks

title: All 32 Online Tools | UtilityPilot
h1: The right tool for the task.
description: Find tools for text, lists, CSV, JSON, images and web publishing. Search by task and browse four focused collections.

title: Text & Lists Tools | UtilityPilot
description: Count, clean, organize and compare text. Turn a messy paste or a repeated list into something ready to use.

title: Data & Tables Tools | UtilityPilot
description: Inspect CSV files, preserve your values and transform JSON. Prepare smaller exports for the next application without opening a spreadsheet.

title: Images Tools | UtilityPilot
description: Resize, crop, convert and compress JPEG, PNG and WebP images. Check dimensions and actual file size before your next upload.

title: Web & Publishing Tools | UtilityPilot
description: Build and inspect links, translate encoded text and check colors. Small publishing tasks, with the details made visible.

title: Word and character counter | UtilityPilot
description: Check the length of a draft, caption or pasted document. See words, visible characters and a reading-time estimate together, with the counting rules made explicit.

title: Text cleaner | UtilityPilot
description: Repair spacing in text copied from documents and websites. Choose exactly which whitespace changes to apply, while keeping your original paste beside the result.

title: Remove duplicate lines | UtilityPilot
description: Remove repeated entries from a newline-separated list. Keep the first or last occurrence, with clear choices for case, whitespace and Unicode matching.

title: Sort lines | UtilityPilot
description: Arrange a list alphabetically, naturally, numerically or by character length. Reverse the existing order when you need the last entry first.

title: Text case converter | UtilityPilot
description: Change capitalization in pasted text without retyping it. Choose lowercase, uppercase, sentence case or title case and review the converted copy.

title: Find and replace text | UtilityPilot
description: Replace repeated literal text in one pass. Preview the full result and match count while keeping the original input intact.

title: Text difference checker | UtilityPilot
description: Compare two drafts or text files and see additions, deletions and unchanged passages. Choose line or word comparison to suit the size of the edits.

title: Compare lists | UtilityPilot
description: Find common and missing entries in two lists. Export their intersection, either one-sided difference, or their combined unique entries.

title: JSON formatter and validator | UtilityPilot
description: Make JSON readable, validate its syntax or produce compact output. Preserve large numeric values and the original order of object members.

title: JSON to CSV converter | UtilityPilot
description: Turn a JSON array of object records into a downloadable table. Choose nested-object flattening and keep only the columns you need.

title: CSV to JSON converter | UtilityPilot
description: Convert a CSV or TSV export into structured JSON. Keep values as strings by default, including identifiers with leading zeros.

title: CSV viewer and validator | UtilityPilot
description: Inspect a CSV or TSV before importing it elsewhere. See columns, record counts and clear syntax errors without spreadsheet type conversion.

title: Remove duplicate CSV rows | UtilityPilot
description: Remove repeated CSV records using a whole row or selected key columns. Choose whether the first or last matching record survives.

title: CSV column editor | UtilityPilot
description: Keep, rename and reorder CSV columns for another application. Adjust the schema while keeping field values unchanged.

title: CSV and TSV delimiter converter | UtilityPilot
description: Convert CSV to TSV or change a comma, semicolon, tab or pipe delimiter. Keep separators inside quoted field values intact.

title: Merge CSV files | UtilityPilot
description: Append several CSV exports under one header. Check that column names and ordering match before combining their records.

title: Split CSV file | UtilityPilot
description: Split a CSV into smaller record batches for an import. Repeat the header in each part and download the numbered files individually.

title: Image resizer | UtilityPilot
description: Resize a JPEG, PNG or WebP to the dimensions you need. Keep the aspect ratio, fit inside a bounding box or deliberately stretch to exact pixels.

title: Image compressor | UtilityPilot
description: Reduce image bytes toward an upload limit and see whether the target was actually met. Keep dimensions unchanged unless you allow resizing.

title: Image format converter | UtilityPilot
description: Convert between static JPEG, PNG and WebP in your browser. Choose a visible background when converting transparent artwork to JPEG.

title: Image cropper | UtilityPilot
description: Remove unwanted edges or frame an image at a chosen ratio. Use pointer selection or precise pixel coordinates to define the crop.

title: Image size and dimension checker | UtilityPilot
description: Check image dimensions, actual bytes, aspect ratio and transparent pixels. Understand which constraint an image needs to meet before editing it.

title: Image color picker | UtilityPilot
description: Pick a color from a precise image pixel, or average a small square area. Copy its HEX, RGB and HSL values for your next design task.

title: URL slug generator | UtilityPilot
description: Turn a title into a readable URL or filename identifier. Choose Latin transliteration or keep Unicode letters, with hyphens or underscores between words.

title: URL and query-string parser | UtilityPilot
description: Break a URL into readable components and ordered query pairs. Preserve repeated parameters and distinguish form-style spaces from literal plus signs.

title: URL encoder and decoder | UtilityPilot
description: Encode a URL component or decode escaped text one layer at a time. Choose the correct space behavior for a URL component or form value.

title: UTM campaign URL builder | UtilityPilot
description: Build a campaign link with consistent UTM fields. Keep unrelated query parameters and the page fragment while reviewing the resulting link.

title: URL tracking parameter cleaner | UtilityPilot
description: Remove selected common tracking parameters while retaining unknown fields. Inspect the cleaned link before sharing it.

title: HEX RGB HSL converter | UtilityPilot
description: Convert HEX, RGB and HSL color notation with a visible swatch. Keep supported alpha values and see the rounding applied to sRGB channels.

title: Color contrast checker | UtilityPilot
description: Check the text contrast between two opaque colors. See the actual ratio and AA/AAA text thresholds, with a preview of your chosen size and weight.

title: Base64 encoder and decoder | UtilityPilot
description: Encode UTF-8 text or decode Base64 and Base64URL locally. When decoded bytes are not text, download the bytes instead of silently changing them.

title: HTML entity encoder and decoder | UtilityPilot
description: Escape HTML characters for display or decode named and numeric entities into plain text. Inspect the output without rendering it as markup.
